verdict.rationale: The SDK axis applies, because a state business-filing service like Ohio Business Central could plausibly publish APIs or SDKs. Nothing in the pack mentions an official SDK, a developer API, or programmatic access. The evidence covers only portal tips, OHID sign-in, and tax-site features. Probes of ohiosos.gov and bsportal.ohiosos.gov hit HTTP 403 at robots.txt, so nothing on the Secretary of State's own sites could be checked for developer resources.
